# csv_content already has the file data. Parse correctly handling \r\n line endings.
lines = csv_content.strip().replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').split('\n')

            'rep': rep_name,
            'region': region,
            'product': product,
            'amount': amount,
